companies.name: Flora & Fauna
companies.distributes: Vegan chocolate (Loco Love, Vego, Pana Organic, Alter Eco, Mummy Meegz), vegan lollies and gummies (Free From Fellows, Dandies, Eco-Vital), snack bars (Clif, Nugo) and other vegan snacks
companies.channels_supplied: Its own national online shop, shipping across Australia to consumers
companies.sf_brands_carried: Free From Fellows sugar-free gummy bears, cola bottles and wine gums
companies.fit_rationale: A 100% vegan, ethical and cruelty-free online shop that already sells chocolate, gummies and bars from other brands, so Diablo's vegan muesli bars, wafer, cookie and spreads fit its food range. It already lists sugar-free sweets from Free From Fellows, a direct competitor, which shows its shoppers buy sugar-free confectionery.
what_they_do_well: Certified B Corp that says it is trusted by more than 250,000 Australians.
Winner and finalist in the 2026 Clean + Conscious Awards.

companies.name: Biome
companies.distributes: Vegan chocolate (Loco Love, Bennetto, Pana, Booja-Booja, Alter Eco, Vego), vegan lollies, healthy snacks, jams and spreads
companies.channels_supplied: Its own eco stores in Brisbane and Melbourne and its online shop, which also ships to the US and Canada
companies.fit_rationale: An eco and vegan store chain with a Chocolate and Snacks section of other brands' vegan chocolate, lollies and healthy snacks, plus jams and spreads. Its own Biome brand covers cleaning and cosmetics, not food, so Diablo's vegan bars, cookie and peanut butters would sit beside third-party brands. Store count: six stores according to Eco Hub Map; Biome's own page names Brisbane and Melbourne stores.
what_they_do_well: Has screened the products it sells for their environmental and ethical standards since 2003.

companies.name: Kind To Earth
companies.distributes: Vegan chocolate bars and chocolate spread (Vego, Buttermilk), lollies and marshmallows (Dandies), biscuits and cookies (Leda, House of Biskota), wafer bars and snacks
companies.channels_supplied: Its own online shop, shipping Australia wide, with chilled items delivered in metro Melbourne
companies.fit_rationale: A 100% vegan online grocery whose snacks section sells chocolate, lollies, biscuits, wafer bars and chocolate spread from other brands, matching most of Diablo's vegan lines. It carries a few items under its own KTE name, but most of the range is third-party brands. It is a small shop; store count and turnover are not stated on its website.

companies.name: Grein Wholesale Australia
companies.distributes: Imported Indonesian and Asian groceries with a confectionery and snacks category: biscuits and wafers (Khong Guan, Oreo, Roma, Tango), candies (Kopiko) and savoury snacks; halal certified imports
companies.channels_supplied: Independent grocers, supermarkets and food retailers in Sydney, Brisbane and the Gold Coast, plus restaurants; B2B online ordering
companies.fit_rationale: A Sydney importer and wholesaler of halal certified Indonesian brands that already sells branded biscuits, wafers and candies to Muslim-serving grocers and supermarkets, which is the TATKO model. It also has a small Grein-branded line, but its range is mainly other companies' brands. Storage: own warehouse at Carnegie Place, Blacktown, with a B2B web shop.
what_they_do_well: Runs weekly delivery routes across Sydney from its Blacktown warehouse and lists stockists in Sydney, Brisbane and the Gold Coast.

companies.name: Asian Pantry
companies.distributes: Online Asian grocery of over 3,000 products with snacks sections for chocolates, candy and gummies, biscuits and crackers, and a halal collection of about 350 products
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers through its own online shop, Australia-wide delivery from a Melbourne warehouse
companies.sf_brands_carried: Has a Sugar Free collection; brands not named on the pages checked
companies.fit_rationale: An online grocer with a dedicated halal collection and its own chocolate, candy and biscuit sections from other brands, serving Malaysian, Indonesian and other Muslim shoppers across Australia. It sells only to shoppers, so it is tier 3. Storage: ships from its own Melbourne warehouse.
what_they_do_well: Rated 4.8 out of 5 from 798 Google reviews and delivers Australia-wide from Melbourne.

companies.name: Turkish Store
companies.distributes: Turkish groceries with a snacks and dessert section: Turkish delight, soft candy and gums, hazelnut cocoa spread (Sarelle), halva and gift boxes
companies.channels_supplied: Direct to shoppers through its own online shop, delivery to every Australian state, pick-up in Roxburgh Park
companies.fit_rationale: An online Turkish grocer serving Turkish and Muslim shoppers that already sells branded sweets, spreads and gift boxes from Turkish brands. It reaches shoppers only and its website does not state halal certification, so it is tier 3. Storage: ships from its Melbourne warehouse.

companies.name: The Kosher Providore
companies.distributes: Branded kosher chocolate such as Elite Kit Kat, packaged groceries (Eskal, Schneiders) and kosher dairy, alongside its bakery and butchery counters
companies.channels_supplied: Its own kosher grocery in Mt Lawley, Perth, with an online product shop
companies.fit_rationale: Perth's kosher grocery, bakery and butchery, whose own web shop lists branded imported confectionery such as Elite chocolate next to packaged kosher groceries from other brands. Tier 3 because it is a single shop and its website blocks automated reading, so the full size of its sweets range is not shown. Storage: sells from its own stock in its Mt Lawley shop, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Serves Perth's Jewish community from beside the Perth Hebrew Congregation as a combined kosher bakery, butchery and grocery.

companies.name: Kosher Kingdom Food Market
companies.distributes: Kosher supermarket selling chocolate bars, wafers, sweets and gummies (lollies), cereals and muesli and other packaged groceries from brands such as Alpha, Klik, Carmit, Baci, Camille Bloch, Elite, Chupa Chups and Mentos
companies.channels_supplied: Its own supermarket at 482B Glen Huntly Road, Elsternwick, plus an online shop with click and collect and home delivery
companies.sf_brands_carried: Sweet William no added sugar dark and vegan chocolate; Elite sugar free sweets; Corniche sugar free candies
companies.fit_rationale: A licensed kosher supermarket whose own online shop has separate chocolates, wafers and lollies sections with many imported and local brands, the model Diablo is looking for. It already stocks sugar free chocolate and sweets (Sweet William, Elite, Corniche), so Diablo's kosher certified no added sugar range fits its shelf; Sweet William competes directly in chocolate.
what_they_do_well: Owner-run family business since about 2012 that claims the greatest kosher range in Australia.
Named by the Sydney Morning Herald in 2014 as a reason to visit Elsternwick.

companies.name: Kraus Foods
companies.distributes: Kosher grocer selling chocolate bars, sweets and gummies, biscuits (Lotus Biscoff), spreads, snacks and chips from brands such as Haribo, Strauss, Paskesz, Alprose, Klik, Whittaker's, Mentos and Werther's
companies.channels_supplied: Its own shop at 62 Glen Eira Road, Ripponlea, plus an online shop with click and collect and delivery
companies.sf_brands_carried: Schmerling's Rosemarie sugar free milk and parve chocolate; Werther's sugar free chocolate candies; GoodnessMe
companies.fit_rationale: A kosher grocery whose own online shop lists 125 confectionery and snacks lines plus chocolates, biscuits and spreads sections, all from other brands. It already sells sugar free kosher chocolate (Schmerling's Rosemarie competes directly), so Diablo's range is a natural addition to an existing better-for-you shelf.
what_they_do_well: Listed by Caulfield Shule and Kosher Australia as one of Melbourne's kosher groceries and a stockist of kosher products.

companies.name: Avenue Hampers
companies.distributes: Gift hampers with branded chocolate (Bahen & Co, Whistlers, Charlotte Piper), sweets and lollies (Sweet-Switch), nougat (Rinaldi, Bramble & Hedge), fudge, toffee, biscuits (Ambrosiana) and cookies (Loaded Cookie)
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate client and staff gifting with branded hampers and bulk multi-address orders, plus online sales to shoppers Australia-wide
companies.fit_rationale: Perth hamper company that sources hamper contents from over 100 Australian businesses and sells corporate branded hampers from 15 units upwards. Its add-on range alone lists dozens of branded chocolate, sweets, nougat, fudge and biscuit lines, so Diablo's chocolate, sweets and biscuits would sit in an existing shelf. Storage: click and collect warehouse at Unit 1, 51 Lancaster Road, Wangara WA.
what_they_do_well: Sources hamper contents from over 100 Australian businesses and offers branded corporate hampers with logo, ribbon and card.

companies.name: Hampers Galore
companies.distributes: Gift hampers and add-ons with branded chocolate (Ferrero Rocher, Whittaker's, Toblerone, Lindt, Chocolatier), cookies (Byron Bay Cookies, Charlie's Cookies) and nougat biscuits (Walters)
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate and bulk hamper orders with no minimum, plus online sales to shoppers Australia-wide with same-day delivery in parts of Melbourne
companies.fit_rationale: Family-owned hamper retailer whose hampers and add-on shelf are built on well-known chocolate and biscuit brands from other companies. It sells corporate hampers in bulk, so Diablo's chocolate, biscuits and gift boxes fit its existing chocolate and snacks range. Storage: orders ship from its own warehouse, address not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Offers bulk corporate hamper pricing with no minimum order and ships Australia-wide via StarTrack.

companies.name: Creative Hampers
companies.distributes: Christmas, gift and corporate hampers with branded chocolate (Chocolatier, Geelong Confectionery, Cocoa Lane), shortbread biscuits (Bisko), nougat (Walters) and gingerbread
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate gifting for teams such as Suncorp, Oracle, Dyson, PEXA and Macquarie University, plus online sales to shoppers Australia-wide
companies.fit_rationale: High-volume hamper company with over 65,000 hampers delivered and a corporate client base shown on its home page. Its sweet hampers combine chocolate, chocolate-coated jellies and biscuits from other brands, matching Diablo's chocolate, sweets and biscuits. Storage: Rouse Hill warehouse in NSW, open for free collection.
what_they_do_well: Over 65,000 hampers delivered, with logos of corporate clients including Suncorp, Oracle and Dyson on its home page.

companies.name: Macarthur Baskets
companies.distributes: Gift hampers and baskets with branded chocolate (Lindt, Ferrero Rocher, Cadbury, Chocolatier, Paton's, Chocolate Grove), biscuits, shortbread, cakes and lollies
companies.channels_supplied: Business and corporate Christmas hampers, bulk and customised orders, plus online sales to shoppers Australia-wide
companies.fit_rationale: Hamper business trading since 1999 that assembles hampers from premium brands and says it supplies Christmas hampers to some of Australia's largest companies. Its range already covers chocolate, biscuits, cakes and lollies from other companies, so Diablo's chocolate boxes, biscuits and cakes fit directly. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Trading since 1999 and states its Christmas hampers have been supplied to some of Australia's largest companies.

companies.name: Gift It Hampers Australia
companies.distributes: Gift hampers with branded sweets and chocolate (Darrell Lea liquorice and Bullets, Lindt Lindor, Ferrero Rocher, Cadbury) and cookies (Byron Bay Cookies, Charlie's Melting Moments)
companies.channels_supplied: Bulk corporate gifts, staff appreciation and client Christmas hampers, plus online sales to shoppers Australia-wide
companies.fit_rationale: Gold Coast hamper retailer whose hampers and chocolate add-ons are built on mainstream branded sweets, chocolate and cookies. It runs bulk corporate and staff gifting, giving Diablo's sweets, chocolate and cookies a ready place in its sweet hampers. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

companies.name: Just In Time Gourmet
companies.distributes: Hampers and a create-your-own range of over 2,000 products, with confectionery and chocolate (Whistlers, Charlotte Piper, Davies Chocolates, Chocolate Grove, Australian Sweet Co), biscuits (Ogilvie & Co, Molly Woppy) and jams
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate Christmas hampers and online sales to shoppers, with free Perth metro delivery and interstate shipping
companies.fit_rationale: Perth hamper retailer with a confectionery and chocolate section listing many other brands, plus biscuit tins built from third-party biscuits, chocolate and jam. Its create-your-own range means Diablo's chocolate, sweets, biscuits and jams could be sold individually and in hampers. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Offers a create-your-own hamper range of more than 2,000 products.

companies.name: Hampers Only
companies.distributes: Gift hampers with branded chocolate (Chocolatier, Bennetto, Fardoulis) and cookies (Snowy Mountain)
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate hampers for clients and staff and online sales to shoppers, with same business day delivery in major cities; part of the Roses Only Group
companies.fit_rationale: National hamper retailer within the Roses Only Group whose chocolate hampers combine several third-party chocolate and cookie brands. It delivers to every capital city and sells corporate hampers, so Diablo's chocolate and cookies fit its chocolate range. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Delivers same business day in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane and Perth as part of the Roses Only Group.

companies.name: Hampers by Design
companies.distributes: Gift hampers with branded chocolate (Lindt, Chocolatier, Walker), shortbread cookies (Ogilvie), sweet sauces and jams
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate gift hampers for clients and employees with corporate branding, plus online sales to shoppers; also trades as Christmas Hampers Perth
companies.fit_rationale: Perth hamper company that fills its hampers with products from Australian producers and named chocolate and biscuit brands. It offers corporate branded hampers and its own Perth delivery team, so Diablo's chocolate, cookies and jams fit its sweet and savoury hampers. Storage: Wangara WA premises shown on its website, delivery by its in-house van team.

companies.name: Snowgoose
companies.distributes: Fruit baskets and gift hampers with branded chocolate (Ferrero), fine and Belgian chocolates and sweet hampers
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate hampers with custom branding through a corporate team, plus online sales to shoppers Australia-wide
companies.fit_rationale: Hamper company filling hampers for more than 30 years from partner growers and artisan providores, with sweet hampers built on branded chocolate. Its corporate team handles custom branded hampers, so Diablo's chocolate and gift boxes fit its sweet range. Storage: orders ship from its warehouse closest to the delivery area.
what_they_do_well: Has filled hampers for more than 30 years and ships from the warehouse closest to each delivery.

companies.name: Thanx Hampers
companies.distributes: Gift hampers with branded chocolate (Chocolatier), cookies (Charlie's Cookies) and snacks
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate hampers for clients such as Westpac, Danfoss and Monash, plus online sales to shoppers with a Melbourne and Sydney focus
companies.fit_rationale: Australian-owned hamper company established in 2001 with a named corporate client list. Its chocolate and treat hampers use third-party chocolate and cookie brands, a direct fit for Diablo's chocolate and cookies. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Established in 2001, with corporate clients including Westpac, Danfoss and Monash named on its site.

companies.name: Pamper Hamper Gifts
companies.distributes: Gift hampers with branded chocolate (Chocolatier Pure Indulgence), fudge, cookies, rock candy and fruit jellies from Random Harvest
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate hampers for staff and clients and online sales to shoppers, with free Sydney delivery on corporate hampers
companies.fit_rationale: Sydney corporate gifting specialist trading since 2004 whose chocolate and sweet tooth hampers are built from other companies' chocolate, fudge, cookies and sweets. Diablo's chocolate boxes, cookies and sweets fit its existing chocolate hamper collection. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Australian owned and operated since 2004 and describes itself as corporate gifting specialists.

companies.name: The Hamper Emporium
companies.distributes: Corporate and gift hampers with chocolate (Maggie Beer), sweets, peanut brittle, caramel and biscuits
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate hampers with branding and a corporate ordering platform, plus online sales to shoppers Australia-wide
companies.fit_rationale: Sydney hamper company that assembles hampers onsite and says it has worked with thousands of Australian organisations. Its sweet and chocolate hampers carry branded chocolate and sweets, so Diablo's chocolate, sweets and biscuits fit its corporate sweet range. Storage: hampers assembled onsite in Sydney, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Runs a dedicated corporate ordering platform and says it has worked with thousands of Australian organisations.

companies.name: Bindle
companies.distributes: Boutique gift hampers with chocolate (Chocamama, Bahen & Co), crackers (Valley Produce Co) and snacks
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate gifting for clients such as Xero, Cbus, Australian Unity and Fulton Hogan, plus online sales to shoppers Australia-wide
companies.fit_rationale: Melbourne corporate gifting company trading since 2012 that sources boutique food from other Australian makers for its hampers. Its chocolate hampers and named corporate accounts make Diablo's chocolate and gift boxes a fit for its client gifting. Storage: ships Australia-wide from its Cheltenham VIC headquarters.
what_they_do_well: Delivering Australian corporate gifts since 2012, with clients including Xero, Cbus and Australian Unity.

companies.name: Gathering Gifts
companies.distributes: Curated corporate hampers with chocolate (Ministry of Chocolate, Thessaly, Cuvee, Kozoko), nougat (Bramble & Hedge) and gingerbread biscuits
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate gifting for over 100 businesses, bespoke and build-your-own hampers and branded gift-of-choice portals
companies.fit_rationale: Melbourne corporate gifting company, formerly Go Above & Beyond, that picks every item from premium brands and specialist suppliers. Its chocolate hampers already feature several chocolate and nougat brands, matching Diablo's chocolate and sweets. Storage: warehouse at 13/210 Boundary Road, Braeside VIC.
what_they_do_well: Says it is trusted by more than 100 businesses across Australia for customised corporate hampers.

companies.name: Yummy Box
companies.distributes: Snack, chocolate and dessert gift boxes with branded chocolate bars (KitKat, Crunchie, M&M's), snacks (Smith's, Cobs popcorn) and confectionery
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate gift boxes and events, plus online sales to shoppers with same-day WA metro delivery and Australia-wide shipping
companies.fit_rationale: Perth gift box company that assembles boxes of mainstream branded chocolate, confectionery and snacks. Its corporate gift boxes and chocolate dessert boxes give Diablo's chocolate bars, sweets and snacks a direct fit. Storage: boxes made in Perth from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

companies.name: Lifes A Hamper
companies.distributes: Artisan food and chocolate hampers with chocolate (Chocamama, Koko Black, Whisk & Pin, Chocilo), gummies and lollies
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate gifts and staff appreciation hampers, plus online sales to shoppers in Sydney, Melbourne and Australia-wide
companies.fit_rationale: Australian-owned hamper company with a chocolate collection and lolly and chocolate gift boxes built from other brands. It runs corporate and staff appreciation ranges, so Diablo's chocolate and gummies fit its existing chocolate boxes. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

companies.name: Parcelle
companies.distributes: Luxury gift hampers with chocolate-coated jellies, coconut rough, shortbread and panettone from Coco Maison
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate gifting for clients such as McGrath, MPC and Rakuten Advertising, with orders of up to 500 gift boxes, plus online sales to shoppers
companies.fit_rationale: Sydney luxury hamper company that curates its hampers in-house from third-party gourmet brands. Its Christmas gift boxes carry branded chocolate and biscuits and it handles large corporate orders, so Diablo's chocolate and biscuits fit. Storage: sells from its own stock with a production floor team in Sydney, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Handles large corporate orders, including one client order of 500 gift boxes cited on its home page.

companies.name: Gift Hamper Collective
companies.distributes: Gift hampers with biscuits and cookies (Luken & May, Byron Bay Cookies, Butterfingers), chocolate (Duck Creek) and snacks (Wallaby Bites)
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate, client and real estate settlement hampers in bulk, plus online sales to shoppers Australia-wide
companies.fit_rationale: Australian-owned hamper company whose sweet hampers are made up entirely of other brands' biscuits, cookies and chocolate. Tier 3 because its head office address is not stated on its website. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

companies.name: Madebox
companies.distributes: Gift boxes and hampers from over 400 independent makers, with fudge, honeycomb, chocolate and sweet and salty snacks
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate gifting programmes for staff, clients, settlements and conferences across Australia and New Zealand
companies.fit_rationale: Corporate gifting company that sources and packs products from over 400 independent Australian makers, including fudge, honeycomb and chocolate. Tier 3 because the brands in its treat boxes and its head office are not named on its website. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.
what_they_do_well: Curates and packs products from over 400 independent makers, handling sourcing, branding, logistics and delivery for corporate clients.

companies.name: Sydney Gift Hampers
companies.distributes: Gift hampers with chocolate (Sapphy, Chocolatier), chocolate-coated jellies, honeycomb and melting moments biscuits
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate gift hampers with a corporate login and bulk orders, plus online sales to shoppers
companies.fit_rationale: Small Sydney hamper business that focuses on products from other local Australian suppliers, including branded chocolate and biscuits. Tier 3 because it is a small business with limited reach. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

companies.name: Hamper Co
companies.distributes: Gift hampers with chocolate bars (Knight and Georgie), rock candy (Aunty Polly's Perfect Lollies), fudge, popcorn and chocolate biscuits
companies.channels_supplied: Corporate gifting and onboarding hampers for clients such as UTS, plus online sales to shoppers
companies.fit_rationale: Social enterprise hamper business linked to the Intellectual Disability Foundation of St George, selling hampers with branded chocolate and lollies from other makers. Tier 3 because it is small and its reach outside Sydney is not stated on its website. Storage: sells from its Kogarah premises, warehouse not named on its website.
